$comment: Single source of truth for the ACE Read-only Bridge tool contract. main.js loads this at runtime, manifest.json mirrors it for the PI plugin host, and test_tool_surface.py asserts the Python MCP server agrees. Changing the surface here and re-running the tests is the only supported way to add or rename a tool.

timeouts_ms.$comment: cli_default is overridden by ACE_BRIDGE_CLI_TIMEOUT, which pi-plugin/main.js and bridge_config.py both read.

read_tools.name: ace_capabilities
read_tools.description: Query ACE bridge capabilities. Read actions do not prove liveness or authorize writes.

read_tools.name: ace_status
read_tools.description: Query ACE persisted status. This does not prove daemon liveness.

read_tools.name: ace_tasks
read_tools.description: Query bounded ACE task summaries without task bodies or credentials.

read_tools.name: ace_learning
read_tools.description: Read ACE self-evolution snapshot metadata. Read-only; does not prove liveness.

read_tools.name: ace_archaeology
read_tools.description: Read bounded archaeology state and append-only lineage receipts.

read_tools.name: ace_governance
read_tools.description: Read bounded governance snapshot metadata. No policy mutation.

read_tools.name: ace_query
read_tools.description: Directly query bounded ACE cognition results for map, library, lineage, capability, status, tasks, history, and relations.

read_tools.name: ace_health
read_tools.description: Health check endpoint for liveness/readiness probes.

read_tools.name: ace_metrics
read_tools.description: Return collected metrics (request counts, latency, errors).

capsule_tool.name: ace_capsule
capsule_tool.description: Run one existing ACE worker-capsule command. ACE validates credentials and pool face.
